# `/reminder-escalations` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /reminder-escalations/v1/config/tenants

`createReminderEscalationTenantConfigV1` — Create Reminder Escalation Tenant Config — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Creates the default reminder and escalation ruleset for a domain object type in the authenticated tenant. A tenant has one default per domain object type. Creating the same type again returns 409.

- Scopes: idn:reminder-escalation-config:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): reminderescalationtenantconfigcreate
- Returns 201: reminderescalationtenantconfig

### GET /reminder-escalations/v1/config/tenants/{domainObjectType}

`getReminderEscalationTenantConfigV1` — Get Reminder Escalation Tenant Config — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Returns the tenant-default reminder and escalation ruleset for a domain object type in the authenticated tenant.

- Scopes: idn:reminder-escalation-config:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `domainObjectType` (path, required) — one of PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN, CERTIFICATION — Domain object type key.
- Returns 200: reminderescalationtenantconfig

### PUT /reminder-escalations/v1/config/tenants/{domainObjectType}

`putReminderEscalationTenantConfigV1` — Update Reminder Escalation Tenant Config — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Replaces the tenant-default ruleset for a domain object type. Send the `revision` from the latest read. A stale revision returns 409.

- Scopes: idn:reminder-escalation-config:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `domainObjectType` (path, required) — one of PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN, CERTIFICATION — Domain object type key.
- Body (application/json): reminderescalationtenantconfigupdate
- Returns 200: reminderescalationtenantconfig

### DELETE /reminder-escalations/v1/config/tenants/{domainObjectType}

`deleteReminderEscalationTenantConfigV1` — Delete Reminder Escalation Tenant Config — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Deletes the tenant-default ruleset for a domain object type in the authenticated tenant.

- Scopes: idn:reminder-escalation-config:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `domainObjectType` (path, required) — one of PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN, CERTIFICATION — Domain object type key.
- Returns 204: no body
